newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Captall buys firm from Saflife.
newsitem.headline: Captall buys firm from Saflife.

text.p: Capital Alliance Holdings Ltd (Captall) said on Thursday it has bought a 60.62 percent stake in South Africa's Global Capital Ltd from its principal shareholder Saflife Ltd for 148.43 million rand.
The transaction, which will be paid by the issue of 5.82 million new Captall shares at an issue price of 25.50 each, took effect from March 27, Captall said in a published announcement.
The new shares issued had been placed with various financial institutions on behalf of Saflife.

In a separate announcement Saflife, which recently bought a 30 percent stake in mining house JCI Ltd in a major black empowerment deal, said the proceeds from the sale would be used to reduce its debt.

Global is an investment trust with holdings in a diverse number of listed firms including motor group Super Group Ltd, investment holding firm Corpgro Ltd and leisure group LeisureNet Ltd. Global has a market value of 244.85 million rand.

Captall said the rationale for the purchase was to acquire a controlling interest in an investement portfolio holding significant stakes in assets seen having medium to long term growth opportunities.

In a separate announcement Saflife said the disposal will rationalise its holdings which will then be focused in the financial services sector via its 47.3 percent holding in Captall and in mining, via JCI Ltd.
